question: Can you calculate the median from the highest season goals of each team?
sql:
-- Calculate total goals per team per season (both home and away)
WITH team_season_goals AS (
    SELECT home_team_api_id AS team_id, season, SUM(home_team_goal) AS total_goals
    FROM Match
    GROUP BY home_team_api_id, season
    UNION ALL
    SELECT away_team_api_id AS team_id, season, SUM(away_team_goal) AS total_goals
    FROM Match
    GROUP BY away_team_api_id, season
),
team_season_totals AS (
    SELECT team_id, season, SUM(total_goals) AS season_goals
    FROM team_season_goals
    GROUP BY team_id, season
),
team_max_season_goals AS (
    SELECT team_id, MAX(season_goals) AS highest_season_goals
    FROM team_season_totals
    GROUP BY team_id
)
SELECT QUANTILE_CONT(highest_season_goals, 0.5) AS MEDIAN_HIGHEST_SEASON_GOALS
FROM team_max_season_goals
